sections.heading: Why collocations matter
sections.body: Collocations are the verb + noun pairs natives always use together. Translating the English verb word by word is one of the most common errors at advanced level: you don't *hacer una decisión*, you *tomas una decisión*.

head: Verb
Collocations
rows: *una decisión, medidas* (measures), *en cuenta* (to take into account), *el pelo* (to tease), *apuntes* (notes), *conciencia* (to become aware)
*un paseo* (a walk), *una vuelta* (a stroll / a spin), *las gracias, un consejo, un examen* (LatAm: to take an exam), *miedo, pena* (to cause fear / pity), *a luz* (to give birth), *importancia*
*una pregunta, caso* (to pay attention), *cola / fila* (to stand in line), *falta* (to be needed), *daño* (to hurt), *una visita, trampa* (to cheat), *un esfuerzo*
*de menos* (to miss), *una mano, la culpa* (to blame), *un vistazo* (to take a look), *una siesta* (LatAm also *tomar una siesta*)
to carry out: *llevar a cabo un proyecto / una investigación*
*una foto, una nota* (a grade), *conclusiones, provecho* (to benefit)
*un riesgo* (to run a risk), *prisa* (to be urgent)

sections.heading: Adjective and noun pairs
sections.body: Some nouns have their own typical adjectives: *una lluvia torrencial* (heavy rain), *un fuerte dolor* (a severe pain), *un grave error* (a serious mistake), *un profundo agradecimiento* (deep gratitude), *una amplia mayoría* (a large majority), *un rotundo éxito* (a resounding success), *una estrecha relación* (a close relationship).

vocab: to go for a stroll / spin
to benefit / make the most of
examples: El gobierno tomó medidas para reducir la inflación.
The government took measures to reduce inflation.
Hay que tomar conciencia del problema.
We need to become aware of the problem.
¿Damos una vuelta por el centro?
Shall we go for a stroll downtown?
Mi prima dio a luz a gemelos.
My cousin gave birth to twins.
Nunca me haces caso.
You never listen to me.
Hace falta más tiempo.
More time is needed.
Te echo de menos.
I miss you.
¿Puedes echarle un vistazo a mi informe?
Can you take a look at my report?
Llevaron a cabo una investigación completa.
They carried out a thorough investigation.
Cometió un grave error.
He made a serious mistake.
Presta atención, por favor.
Please pay attention.
Saqué una buena nota en el examen.
I got a good grade on the exam.
Hay que sacar provecho de la experiencia.
We have to make the most of the experience.
No quiero correr ese riesgo.
I don't want to run that risk.
Cayó una lluvia torrencial.
There was torrential rain.
La obra fue un rotundo éxito.
The play was a resounding success.
Tienen una relación muy estrecha.
They have a very close relationship.
